title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
script:
NVIDIA is deploying frontier AI agents to build 3D simulations inside the Omniverse platform.
Developers use these agents to assemble assets and connect physics across their virtual environments.
These agents utilize Omniverse libraries to handle complex rendering and ensure scenes behave as expected.
Engineers are building these applications to investigate potential failures and improve product designs.
The agents act as assistants to help developers check that every scene functions correctly.
Developers are also using these AI tools to explore various operational scenarios in digital twins.
Would you trust an AI agent to stress-test your next vehicle design?
